taskChanges.newValue: Root cause: TeamsTab.getTeamPower reduced custom team heroIds directly; object-shaped nested member storage reaches that call although outer teams are normalized. CACHE_HEROES_UPDATED is informational. Reproduced using object-shaped legacy fixtures; the user's exact custom storage was not supplied. Added teamMemberIds/serverTeamGroups normalization at account load/save, server team groups, edit and power boundaries, preserving hero/titan membership and ignoring invalid values. Actual compiled Teams render and actual Chrome storage refresh prove power 3000 -> 9000 with no runtime exceptions. Evidence: docs/acceptance/teams-2026-11-15.json (Chrome, extension 0.10.88, local fixture). Verification: full suite 806 tests, 794 passed, 12 optional private-log skips; typecheck and production build passed at 0.10.88. Review: PASS.
